method: Built-in ImageGen; one enemy per call; true transparent background
common_prompt_template:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw ONE existing game enemy as a standalone transparent full-body asset. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: use its exact subject identity, original pose/action, silhouette, framing and palette. The only composition adjustment requested is turning the original subject to face VIEWER-LEFT; adapt the same pose to a clear left-facing three-quarter angle, roughly 45 degrees, with head, torso and gaze oriented toward the LEFT edge. Keep the original camera distance, body proportions and full subject scale; retain all defining equipment and parts. No forward-facing eye contact or right-facing stance. Images 2, 3 and 4 are DRAWING STYLE references only: broad opaque brush construction, grouped dark cloth, economical anime faces. Do not copy their people, outfits, poses or backgrounds.

SUBJECT: {{subject}}

STYLE: hand-painted anime illustration in large connected opaque color masses, a few wide directional strokes and blunt dabs, grouped hard-edged shadows and decisive handmade edges. Complete clean readable silhouette with selective drawing of eyes, hands and important props. Hair in substantial locks, cloth in principal fold planes; metal, bark, ice, fur and scales in broad quiet planes, with only a few structural accents. Retain the target palette with concentrated vivid accents. Avoid dense fine contour networks, tiny engraved ornament, individual hairs, dense fur strands, facet mosaics, glossy 3D rendering, all-over grain and scratches.

TRANSPARENCY: genuinely transparent RGBA background, including gaps between limbs, weapons and floating effects. Remove every original cream/white paper background. No opaque backdrop, no drawn checkerboard, no floor, no ground shadow, no aura disk or scenery. Keep subject pixels solid/readable; magic accents may have restrained translucent edges. Entire subject and defining accessories in frame with small transparent margins. No text, watermarks, labels, frame or UI. One individual enemy only.

subjects.infantry: The blue-uniformed infantry soldier: helmet with raised visor, short dark blue hair, olive tactical vest and pouches, blue knee pads, gloves and combat boots. Preserve the upright two-foot planted pose holding one black assault rifle diagonally across his chest with both hands. Turn soldier and rifle toward viewer-left; the muzzle points diagonally down-left.
subjects.archer: The brown-haired blue-uniformed marksman with blue goggles and headset, tactical vest and single shoulder armor. Keep his two-knee kneeling pose, torso upright, both hands holding the single long scoped rifle directly in front. Rotate this same kneeling setup toward viewer-left so the face, chest and rifle aim diagonally left and slightly downward; preserve a readable long rifle and both bent knees, not a new standing pose.
subjects.bandit: The orange-haired mohawk bandit in an orange tactical vest, orange torn open jacket, orange cargo pants, orange boots, belt chain and wrapped forearm. Preserve the forward running lunge, one knee lifted behind, one arm back and one hand carrying a single machete diagonally down. Rotate the running silhouette toward the left edge; the leaning torso, face, leading foot and machete trajectory all read as leftward. Keep his fierce grin.
subjects.cavalry: The blond blue-eyed motorcycle cavalry trooper: goggles on forehead, black long tactical coat and gloves, silver shoulder plate and long silver spear held diagonally downward. Preserve the full standing figure in front of his single cobalt-blue sport motorcycle, rearward spear upper tip and low spear blade. Reorient figure AND motorcycle toward viewer-left, with the motorcycle front wheel and nose at the LEFT and rear wheel at the RIGHT. Keep motorcycle behind the figure and complete enough to read both wheels, not a mounted riding action.
subjects.orc_jav: The buzz-cut gas-mask raider with orange goggle lenses, orange scarf, ragged brown long coat, tan tactical trousers and boots, and strapped orange canisters at one thigh. Preserve standing centered with both hands holding one brown/orange rifle diagonally across his chest, turn the head, torso and muzzle toward viewer-left; muzzle slants down-left. He remains this masked human raider, do not invent an orc or a javelin.
subjects.orc_axe: The massive horned skeletal armored creature: gray-green animal-skull helmet with tusks, huge spikes on its shoulders, pale external ribs and plate armor over black flesh with vivid acid-green branching fissures, large clawed hands and feet. Preserve the wide planted stance, arms lowered and hands spread away from hips. Rotate the whole creature to a readable LEFT-facing three-quarter angle with skull snout pointing left, preserve the huge upper silhouette, horns, ribs and armor. Do not add an axe or human.
subjects.wolf_rider: The single ferocious white ice wolf with red eyes, bared fangs, enormous ice spikes standing up from its arched back and bushy tail. Preserve its low four-legged pouncing stance, lowered snarling head and towering dorsal ice silhouette; reorient the entire wolf toward the LEFT, muzzle low at left, body continuing to right and tail behind at right. Show all four paws and icy back, same predatory crouch, not an upright wolf, and no rider.
subjects.fire_el: The slender faceless humanoid fire elemental, a full body of orange/red flame with a bright yellow chest and a tall upward flame head, both arms hanging down and feet close together. Preserve the hovering upright pose, slim proportions and a few attached tongues of flame at shoulders, forearms and ankles. Rotate its torso and faceless head into a clear LEFT-facing three-quarter silhouette; flame head suggests the face plane toward left. Not a human wearing clothes.
subjects.water_el: The cyan liquid humanoid water elemental wearing separated dark teal horned and spiked armor plates on head, shoulders, forearms, knees and feet. Preserve the tall slim upright figure, arms down and dripping liquid joining the floating rib/plate pieces around its luminous aqua body. Rotate torso, armored head and feet toward the LEFT in three-quarter view. Keep drips close to the body and preserve real alpha around and between armor pieces.
subjects.grass_el: The tall olive/forest-green tree humanoid with bark muscles, tangled vine forearms and calves, yellow flowers on both shoulders, a woody crown-like spiky head with two hollow dark eye sockets, tiny green/yellow glowing buds near shoulders and chest. Preserve standing upright with arms low, root-shaped feet, full body. Turn its head and torso toward LEFT in clear three-quarter view, retaining shoulder flower clusters and the original slim long-limbed proportions.
subjects.dragon: The single dark violet/black bone-armored dragon with immense raised ragged wings, a horned roaring snout, purple glowing eyes/mouth/chest, bone external ribs and purple branching energy veins, four legs with huge talons. Preserve the low roaring four-legged pose beneath tall spread wings and the original full creature composition. Reorient the complete dragon to LEFT-facing three-quarter view: head and open mouth toward left, chest turned left, body extending right with hind legs farther back, wings still raised high. Keep wings inside the image with small clear padding rather than clipping them. Do not add a rider.
subjects.esper_crow: The white/silver bob-haired blue-eyed female psychic in a dark navy military long coat/cape with silver buttons, pale gloves and knee-high boots. Preserve centered upright full-body pose, hands meeting in the original two-handed casting gesture at chest height, floating cyan crystal shards around the hands and upper torso. Rotate the woman and her casting gesture toward LEFT in three-quarter view, eyes looking left; keep the navy coat silhouette and the focused cyan crystal cluster, no birds or new props.
subjects.esper_candle: The short tousled blond-haired amber-eyed female fire psychic wearing an orange scarf trailing to one side, cropped gray shirt, open dark leather jacket, fitted black pants, bandaged hands and combat boots. Preserve upright wide-foot stance, one palm raised near chest holding a single small bright flame and the other hand down. Rotate head, torso, boots and raised-palm gesture toward LEFT, gaze left; scarf tails trail behind her toward the right. Keep original outfit and exposed small midriff, no new action.
subjects.esper_silence: The silver-haired amber-eyed male psychic in a black face mask, dark gray long tactical coat with blue lapels and blue inner cape panels, black pants and boots. Preserve full upright figure, one gloved hand raised open at chest height and other arm down, with several thin iridescent cyan rings circling the forearm and upper waist. Rotate head, body and open-palm gesture toward LEFT in three-quarter view, gaze left; keep the rings as a few readable arcs and the coat's original long flowing silhouette.
subjects.esper_echo: The tousled dark gray-haired amber-eyed male psychic with headset, dark gray-green tattered tactical coat with orange lining and shoulder patch, black/gray pants and boots with orange sole accents, and bandaged wrists. Preserve full standing stance and both hands held together near his chest surrounding the small orange sound-wave effect. Rotate his whole stance, head and hands toward LEFT in clear three-quarter view, eyes left; keep the original orange waveform concentrated between the hands.
subjects.boss_general: The stern middle-aged silver-gray-haired bearded general in a cobalt-blue long mantle with gold shoulder epaulettes and trim, black double-breasted tunic, gray armored boots and black gloves. Preserve his composed upright full-body pose, one hand holding a tall silver-and-gold halberd vertically beside him, other arm down, broad coat/cape extending behind. Rotate head and torso toward LEFT in three-quarter view, gaze left. Keep the halberd at the leading left side with its full top blade visible and preserve the original blue/gold silhouette; simplify tiny engraving.
subjects.boss_orc: The gigantic bulky dark gray-green spiked brood beast with a very large horned armored head, enormous abdomen, glowing lime-green branching veins on shoulders/chest, a hanging cluster of round luminous green egg sacs below its belly, large outer arms and small inner arms near its stomach, tusks and clawed feet. Preserve all original limbs, wide feet stance, heavy belly, spiky shoulders and egg-sac silhouette; rotate the complete body and horned face toward LEFT in clear three-quarter view. Not a conventional humanoid orc, no weapon.
subjects.boss_elem: The long violet-haired pale blue-skinned androgynous elemental sovereign with purple eyes, a floating pointed violet crystal crown, dark long formal robe with lilac gem-shaped accents, long hair spreading out behind the shoulders and large lavender/cyan crystalline shards floating along both sides. Preserve full upright floating figure with hands relaxed down, robe to ankles and pointed boots, centered large hair/crystal silhouette. Rotate head, torso and boots toward LEFT in clear three-quarter view, gaze left; keep the crown and chest diamond prominent and simplify the robe's tiny ornamentation.
